correctness.rationale: For every m=1,...,5 the exact sparse rational primal and dual vectors in certificates.json satisfy every incidence inequality and attain the same objective; integral code witnesses attain the floor. At m=5 the verified 19/2 upper bound forces at most nine codewords and the nine-word code attains nine. A separately implemented exhaustive Bron–Kerbosch compatibility-clique search on all 42 words enumerates exactly eleven nine-word maximal cliques and nine fixed classes under reversed complement; exact-arithmetic and graph checks are executable in the embedded paths. No claim is extended beyond m=5. The verifier also checks the 77/88 symmetric-difference comparison to the distinct deletion channel.
